verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an extensive public Core API covering cards, users, businesses, card products, card state transitions, transactions, velocity and authorization controls, and disputes. It also offers a sandbox, interactive in-browser API widgets, and a quick-start tutorial, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API's use.
